items.question: How long does onboarding take?
items.answer: Most locations are fully operational within one business day. We help you import your menu, set up delivery zones, and connect your team to their Telegram bots.

items.question: Can I keep my current POS?
items.answer: Toster has its own POS module, but we also have an open API for custom integrations. Talk to us about your current setup.

items.question: How does Toster handle multiple countries?
items.answer: Natively. Each division can have its own currency, language, tax rules, and payment gateway. Fiscalization is handled automatically per jurisdiction.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Data is isolated per organization at the database level. We use JWT authentication, HMAC-signed webhooks, audit logs on every change, and rate limiting. GDPR-compliant with data export and deletion endpoints.

items.question: Do you support aggregators?
items.answer: We support 11 aggregator platforms natively: Bolt, Glovo, Wolt, DoorDash, UberEats, GrubHub, JustEat, Pyszne.pl, DameJidlo, and more. Orders come in unified, statuses sync back automatically.

items.question: What if I only have one location?
items.answer: Toster works great for single locations. You get the full platform and can add more locations whenever you're ready — no migration needed.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing is based on your number of locations and order volume. Request a demo and we'll put together a proposal that fits your scale.
